raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fixes #62308. Since #59533, `Qwen4ExpForCausalLM.packed_modules_mapping["qkv_proj"]` lists `indexer.index_qk_proj`. Quant configs read that class-level mapping before the model is built, so they check q/k/v and the QSA indexer as one fused layer. Checkpoints that quantize q/k/v but keep the indexer in BF16 fail to load with `Found different quantization schemes for the shards of ...qkv_proj`.

This PR keeps the indexer out of the mapping that quant configs see, and fuses it into `qkv_proj` only when both resolve to the same quant method.

## Claims

- Checkpoints with quantized q/k/v and a BF16 indexer load again, for example `ukisai/Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-W4A16-AWQ`. Their indexer runs as its own GEMM, as before #59533.
- No change for BF16, ModelOpt FP4, and checkpoints that treat q/k/v and the indexer the same way: the indexer stays fused.
- The `--enable-lora` mapping override is removed. It is no longer needed, and it never reached the quant config.

## Validation

End to end on 4x A100-PCIE-40GB (TP4 + EP) with the `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly` image built from `1b2a666` (2026-10-18). Its `model.py` and `qsa.py` match this PR's base `371745e`; for "after", the two files from this PR were mounted over them. A test-only hook (not part of this PR) logged the fusion decision of every QSA layer.

| Checkpoint | Code | Server start | QSA layers (12 per worker, 4 workers) | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ukisai/Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-W4A16-AWQ` (q/k/v W4A16, indexer BF16) | before | fails: `ValueError: Found different quantization schemes ... layers.3.self_attn.qkv_proj` | - | - |
| same | after | ok | 48/48 unfused: `QKVParallelLinear` (`CompressedTensorsWNA16`) + BF16 `index_qk_proj` | GSM8K 86.2% (n=500), 0 invalid |
| `cyankiwi/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-AWQ-INT4` (attention BF16) | before | ok | 48/48 fused (`Qwen4ExpQSAQKVIndexerLinear`) | - |
| same | after | ok | 48/48 fused, same layer and quant method | sample request ok |

Both GPU runs used an earlier revision of the fusion check. The final check makes the same decision for both checkpoints: different quant methods for Swift, the same for cyankiwi.

GSM8K (an API key header was added by a small wrapper):

```bash
python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --port 8002 --use-chat-completions \
  --model swift-1.5-flash-next-awq --reasoning-effort none --num-shots 0 \
  --num-questions 500 --max-tokens 512 --temperature 0 --max-concurrency 32
```

The default 5-shot completions mode does not suit this model family: it emits EOS right after `Answer:` once the prompt is longer than about 400 tokens, on vLLM and on llama.cpp alike.

- Unit test (CPU): `test_qkv_proj_mapping_allows_bf16_indexer` in `tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_config.py`. With the old mapping, both cases fail with the error from #62308.
- `pre-commit run --files <changed files>`: passed.
- CI: the test runs in the existing CPU Qwen4 Exp step (`qwen4-exp-unit-tests-cpu`). CI has no Flash-Next checkpoint with this layout (about 165 GB), so the end-to-end load is validated only as above.

## Details

- Root cause: `configure_quant_config` passes the class-level `packed_modules_mapping` to the quant config before `__init__` runs. Even the plain `QKVParallelLinear` built before fusion is resolved as a four-shard layer. The LoRA branch rebinds the mapping on the instance, so the quant config never saw it.
- Change:
  - `packed_modules_mapping["qkv_proj"]` is `["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj"]` for both model classes.
  - `Qwen4ExpQSAAttention` builds q/k/v and the indexer as before, then fuses only if both resolve to the same quant method type. Without a quant config for the fused layer (BF16, or ModelOpt FP4 via `without_modelopt_fp4`) it fuses as before.
- Limitation: if q/k/v and the indexer are both quantized with the same quant method but a different scheme or parameters (bits or group size), they are still fused, and loading fails at weight loading. I have not seen a checkpoint with this layout.
- I used AI assistance (Claude) for the investigation, the code and the tests. I reviewed every changed line and ran the tests and GPU checks above.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

 from vllm.config import CacheConfig, ParallelConfig
 from vllm.config.speculative import SpeculativeConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.compressed_tensors.utils import (
+    should_ignore_layer,
+)
 from vllm.model_executor.models.config import (
     Qwen3_5ForConditionalGenerationConfig,
     Qwen4ExpForConditionalGenerationConfig,
 )
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.nvidia.model import (
+    Qwen4ExpForCausalLM,
+    Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration,
+)
 from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.nvidia.model_state import Qwen4ExpModelState
 from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_states.mamba_hybrid import MambaHybridModelState
 
@@ -287,3 +294,19 @@ def test_qwen4_exp_model_state_prepares_stable_dummy_ngram_inputs() -> None:
     )
     assert second["query_start_loc"].data_ptr() == query_start_loc_ptr
     assert second["ngram_context"].data_ptr() == ngram_context_ptr
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "model_cls", [Qwen4ExpForCausalLM, Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration]
+)
+def test_qkv_proj_mapping_allows_bf16_indexer(model_cls) -> None:
+    """Regression test for https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/62308.
+
+    Layout of e.g. ukisai/Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-W4A16-AWQ: q/k/v are
+    quantized and only the indexer projection is in `ignore`.
+    """
+    assert not should_ignore_layer(
+        "model.layers.3.self_attn.qkv_proj",
+        ignore=["model.layers.3.self_attn.indexer.index_qk_proj"],
+        fused_mapping=model_cls.packed_modules_mapping,
+    )

@@ -693,8 +693,11 @@ class Qwen4ExpForCausalLM(
     Qwen4ExpMixtureOfExperts,
     IsHybrid,
 ):
+    # The QSA indexer is not listed: quant configs read this mapping before the
+    # model is built, and `Qwen4ExpQSAAttention` fuses `indexer.index_qk_proj`
+    # into `qkv_proj` only when it is quantized like q/k/v.
     packed_modules_mapping = {
-        "qkv_proj": ["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj", "indexer.index_qk_proj"],
+        "qkv_proj": ["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj"],
         "gate_up_proj": ["gate_proj", "up_proj"],
         "kv_proj": ["key_proj", "value_proj"],
         "in_proj_qkvz": ["in_proj_qkv", "in_proj_z"],
@@ -713,12 +716,6 @@ class Qwen4ExpForCausalLM(
     def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
         super().__init__()
         config: Qwen4ExpTextConfig = vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
-        if vllm_config.lora_config is not None:
-            # LoRA does not support the merged QKV/indexer projection, so its
-            # packed mapping must keep the indexer separate.
-            self.packed_modules_mapping = self.packed_modules_mapping | {
-                "qkv_proj": ["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj"],
-            }
         self.vllm_config = vllm_config
         self.model_config = vllm_config.model_config
         self.quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
@@ -963,12 +960,6 @@ def get_model_state_cls():
     def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "model") -> None:
         nn.Module.__init__(self)
         config: Qwen4ExpConfig = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
-        if vllm_config.lora_config is not None:
-            # LoRA does not support the merged QKV/indexer projection, so its
-            # packed mapping must keep the indexer separate.
-            self.packed_modules_mapping = self.packed_modules_mapping | {
-                "qkv_proj": ["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj"],
-            }
         quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
         multimodal_config = vllm_config.model_config.multimodal_config
         if multimodal_config is None:

@@ -505,13 +505,21 @@ def __init__(
                 or current_platform.has_device_capability(89)
             )
         )
-        self.fuse_indexer_projection = vllm_config.lora_config is None
+        # Without a quant config here (BF16, or ModelOpt FP4, which keeps
+        # attention in BF16) the fused layer is unquantized. Otherwise the
+        # indexer shares the q/k/v GEMM only if it uses the same quant method.
+        fused_quant_config = model.without_modelopt_fp4(quant_config)
+        projection_method = type(self.qkv_proj.quant_method)
+        self.fuse_indexer_projection = vllm_config.lora_config is None and (
+            fused_quant_config is None
+            or projection_method is type(self.indexer.index_qk_proj.quant_method)
+        )
         if self.fuse_indexer_projection:
             self.index_qk_size = self.indexer.index_qk_proj.output_size
             self.qkv_proj = Qwen4ExpQSAQKVIndexerLinear(
                 self.qkv_proj,
                 self.index_qk_size,
-                model.without_modelopt_fp4(quant_config),
+                fused_quant_config,
             )
             del self.indexer.index_qk_proj
